questions.stem:
Practice form 3.
Which statement about real numbers is true?
A) √2 is irrational
B) Every irrational number is negative
C) The sum of two rational numbers is irrational
D) 0 is not a real number

options.B: Every irrational number is negative
options.C: The sum of two rational numbers is irrational

questions.explanation: The square root of 2 cannot be written as a ratio of integers.
